_sources: provisions: DED-AGNIVEER-* provision1961 (s.80CCH) and provision2025 (s.125); S2 heading "Deduction in respect of contribution to Agnipath Scheme". summary: S2 s.125(1), (2), s.16(l); 1961 s.80CCH (FA 2023 s.39), s.17(1)(ix) (sources M12, M14; D-140). routes[0]: DED-AGNIVEER-OWN. routes[1]: DED-AGNIVEER-GOVERNMENT. disqualifiers[0]: DED-AGNIVEER-OWN regimes (s.202(2)(a)(xii); s.115BAC(2)(i)).
summary: If you are enrolled in the Agnipath Scheme, what you subscribe to your Agniveer Corpus Fund account is deducted in full, and so is what the Central Government contributes to it. The Government's contribution is also counted as your salary, so the two cancel out for it. The default regime keeps the deduction of the Government's contribution but not of your own.

routes.name: Your own subscription
routes.description: The whole of what you paid into the Fund in the year is deducted.

routes.name: The Central Government's contribution
routes.description: The whole of what the Government contributed to your account is deducted, in every regime.

disqualifiers.description: Your own subscription is not deducted in the default regime.
